title: Link ping attributes enabled hidden outbound beacons

reproduction.beforeFix: All link ping variants returned pass through registry admission. Chromium confirms that clicking an anchor with ping=https://collector.invalid/ping emits a request to that URL.
reproduction.browserEvidence: The probe used a local HTTP page, clicked the link, observed https://collector.invalid/ping, and aborted the request in Playwright before network access.

rootCause: The registry URL-attribute allowlist omitted ping, an attribute that sends one or more hidden POST beacons when a link is activated.
remediation: Treat ping on anchor and area elements as an outbound request; inspect JSX, React factories, object spreads, assignments, setAttribute, and Object.assign using the normalized resource URL classifier.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "hidden outbound link ping beacons"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: JSX anchor ping returned pass
validation.targetedAfterFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "hidden outbound link ping beacons"
validation.targetedAfterFixResult: passed; JSX, React factory, direct property, setAttribute URL list, and Object.assign beacons are rejected

runtimeBoundary: A browser beacon probe was intercepted and aborted before external network access. No contributed script or component code was executed. Deployed CSP verification remains pending.
